result.summary: The attacking team in white breaks forward through the right-central channel, carrying possession toward the attacking third while the defending team retreats centrally to protect the box.

observations.title: Central build-up and release
observations.body: The midfield player receives facing forward and quickly slides a pass between defensive lines to a teammate breaking through the right-central channel.

observations.title: Defensive transition shape
observations.body: The defending back line recovers centrally, funneling the dribbler toward the right touchline while closing inside passing lanes.

observations.title: Forward carrying into attacking third
observations.body: The attacker drives diagonally forward toward the penalty area, attracting multiple defenders as supporting attackers begin their runs inside.
